pages.title: A loud alarm · 1/3
paragraphs: It is seven in the morning in a quiet building in Boston. Ana makes breakfast in her small kitchen. She puts bread in the toaster and goes to the bathroom. Suddenly, a loud alarm fills the hall. Her neighbor Joe knocks at her door. His face is pale and worried.
“Ana! Do you hear that? The smoke alarm!” says Joe. “Yes! Is there a fire?” says Ana. “I don’t know. I’ll check the kitchen.” says Joe.
